name: Chatterbox Voice Changer
author: Resemble AI
summary: Speech-to-speech: re-voices a recording in a chosen voice while keeping the words and timing. Uses Chatterbox's S3 speech tokens and S3Gen decoder; runs in the Python helper.

license.name: MIT
license.summary: Free to use, including commercially. Only convert voices you have permission to use.

parameters.label: Quality steps
parameters.help: Flow-matching steps when rendering the new voice. Fewer is faster; in Encore's tests the result changed little between 4 and 30 steps, and 2 was still intelligible.

parameters.label: Voice guidance
parameters.help: Classifier-free guidance toward the target voice. Its effect is subtle: in Encore's tests, 0 to 1.5 all kept the words and landed close to the target voice.
